trust_decision.summary: Whether an admin-set file path setting (Plugin.Kafka_rdkafka_config, read by parse_ini_file and handed to rdkafka; MISP.log_errors_ndjson_path, written by JsonLogTool) is trusted is decided only by the per-setting 'test' validator in Server::serverSettingsEditValue; the sinks re-read Configure with no check of their own. At the pinned commit both validators ALREADY exist.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'arbitrary rdkafka configuration path'. getKafkaPubTool reads Plugin.Kafka_rdkafka_config and calls parse_ini_file on it; the setting definition is at app/Model/Server.php:7788.

fix_sites.entry_point: none security-relevant: BackgroundJobsTool::__construct backfills defaults and coerces max_job_history_ttl (a robustness fix for a typed Redis::setex call, reached from every job enqueue)

fix_sites.module_kind: model validator (app/Model/Server.php testLogPath); already present at the pinned commit as testNDJSONLogPath (app/Model/Server.php:2333-2408)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The diff contains no rdkafka change at all. The rdkafka validator (app/Model/Server.php:2410-2482) and the ndjson validator (app/Model/Server.php:2333-2408) are both already in the pinned tree.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: forceSave route: 'force is an explicit admin override, and invalid values are allowed on purpose' (app/Model/Server.php:2688).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A legitimate /etc/rdkafka.ini (the default value) and an empty value (no ini parsed) must keep working; the ndjson log must still default to APP/tmp/logs and allow /var/log.

O6_input_shapes: file name with an executable extension segment

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The forceSave flag (web 'force' field, CLI --force, TrainingShell always true) skips the path validator, and the value is saved and later loaded by the sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Force is a documented admin override for invalid values.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the validators; callers in app/Controller/ServersController.php:1610-1611, app/Console/Command/AdminShell.php:669, app/Console/Command/TrainingShell.php:191

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The sinks use the configured path with no validation at load time, so a value already in config.php (written before the validator existed, or force-saved) reaches parse_ini_file and file_put_contents.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Other path-typed settings validated only by testForPath/testForEmpty that feed a file loader.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MISP has many admin-set path settings that share a generic validator.

O9_family: CWE-829 untrusted file/config loading via admin-set path setting (config-to-RCE)
